For a Seychellois passport holder on a 30-day trip to Vietnam, you'll need an e-Visa — the visa-free arrangement only covers stays up to 14 days, and your 30-day trip exceeds that.

Key details:
- E-Visa allows stays of up to 90 days, single or multiple entry.
- Cost: USD 25 for single entry, USD 50 for multiple entry.
- Apply at https://evisa.gov.vn/; processing typically takes 2-3 business days (expedited options available for a higher fee).
- Valid for entry by air, land, or sea at any of the approved e-Visa ports.
- Your passport must be valid for at least 180 days from your entry date.

Note: this data is current as of 2026-08-17 in my records — I'd recommend double-checking the latest requirements at evisa.gov.vn before you travel, since policies can change.
